Nusens TV Box Vinyl Equipment Wrap

Would you love to win this 65” LG UHD TV? Nusens.ca, one of our regular clients, is doing a Christmas giveaway. They are giving this amazing branded gift away on Saturday at their Christmas party to their staff.
Thanks to our team here at Vinyl Wrap Toronto we were easily able to complete this custom wrap. The TV Box was dropped off in the morning and completed the same day for the big night. The customer was impressed as it was a last-minute job. We pulled everything together using Quality Avery Dennison Vinyl Wrapping material. Our graphic designers were able to make the graphics look like the original box image on this equipment wrap.
We take the ordinary and convert it into the extraordinary. Would you like to wrap an unusual item to brand it? We can wrap almost anything, putting your Company Logo on to make it extra special.
